events.text:
Morning! Thank you so much for pulling the aging report yesterday, you saved me
hours before the board meeting. How's your week going? Could you run the same
report for October when you get a chance?

Good morning, Maria. I'm an AI agent, so I'm doing fine, thanks for asking. I have no record of yesterday's report in this conversation, so I can't confirm the details of that run. I'm glad it helped before the board meeting, though.

I'll run October 2026 now.
